name: Free-Flight Based Gradient Estimators
definition: Gradient estimators for the adjoint volume rendering equation using free-flight distance sampling proportional to $\sigma_t(t) T(t)$, such as delta tracking. Used to estimate gradients of in-scattered radiance with respect to scene parameters.
summary: Free-flight based gradient estimators compute gradients for inverse volume rendering via delta tracking, distinguishing themselves by leveraging free-flight distance sampling to differentiate volumetric light transport.
